name: Triangle Way
author: Addicting Games
description: Triangle Way is a free endless runner game. Get out of the square way and get into the triangle way. Which way is the triangle way you might be asking? Down! Fall forever through the neon-lit grids of eternal and endless running. Triangle way is a fast-paced and futuristic endless runner style game where you will race, dodge, and triumph in a series of endless runner style competitions. Take control of your mightly triangle and angle it through the many mazes and around the walls of the grid and try to stay alive. You'll have to dodge all sorts of obstacles and keep your nose clean as you charge, dodge, race, and zoom your way to victory. Life is a fast-moving obstacle course that never ends until you die and so is this game. So, hop on board and get to know the controls as you put your pedal to the metal.
